scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix client && npm test --prefix server
scripts.format: prettier --write . && npm run format --prefix client && npm run format --prefix server
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && npm run format:check --prefix client && npm run format:check --prefix server
